limitations: Manufacturer exterior CAD only; board/display/peripheral runtime unavailable.
No physical hardware measurements; colors are photograph-informed approximations, not calibrated materials.
PCB has no audited complete board layout and is represented only by a visible neutral UNKNOWN placeholder.

Catalog dimensions refer to camera controller24×24×13.5mm; audio base separately24×24×14.14mm. Assembled plastic CAD23.5mm total is a CAD measurement, not an independently documented full-kit envelope.
Audio base is named Atomic Voice Base by text but photographed labels say ATOMIC ECHO BASE; naming/revision correspondence remains unconfirmed.
Tiny isolated one-triangle source pieces8/11 are retained as omitted tessellation fragments, not interpreted as complete mechanical parts.
Paper/optical projection is isolated from molded shell; small printed markings and hidden hardware not supplied by source CAD may remain incomplete.
